cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: to introduce the topic and clarify key target vocabulary for the session.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Review the key vocabulary for this session below:

cosy-blockquote.p: Handwriting – writing with a pen or pencil in your hand.

p.em: Example: His handwriting is very neat and clean.

cosy-blockquote.p: Typing – writing words on a computer or phone keyboard.

p.em: Example: I am learning fast typing in my computer class.

cosy-blockquote.p: Keyboard – the board with keys that you use to write on a computer.

p.em: Example: My laptop keyboard has small letters on it.

cosy-blockquote.p: Pen – an object that you use to write with ink on paper.

p.em: Example: Can I borrow your blue pen for a moment?

cosy-blockquote.p: Paper – thin sheets of material used for writing, printing, or drawing.

p.em: Example: Please write your name on this white sheet of paper.

cosy-blockquote.p: Fast – moving or happening at high speed; not slow.

p.em: Example: Typing on a computer is very fast and easy.

cosy-blockquote.p: Slow – not moving quickly; taking a long time.

p.em: Example: Writing by hand is slow but very enjoyable.

cosy-blockquote.p: Notebook – a book with empty pages used for writing notes.

p.em: Example: I write my English vocabulary list in a green notebook.

cosy-blockquote.p: Comfortable – producing physical ease; pleasant and relaxing.

p.em: Example: My office chair is very comfortable to sit on.

cosy-blockquote.p: Mistake – an action or decision that is incorrect or wrong.

p.em: Example: You can erase a pencil mistake easily with an eraser.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: pair/group discussion on core session themes.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs or small breakout groups, discuss the following questions:

A: Good handwriting is a beautiful personal skill. B: Typing is a fast way to write.
★ Do you have neat handwriting?

A: Learning typing helps you in school. B: Writing by hand helps your memory.
★ Is your typing speed fast?

A: A computer keyboard is very easy to use. B: Writing with a pen feels creative.
★ What computer keyboard do you use?

A: A simple pen never runs out of battery. B: A computer lets you edit easily.
★ Do you write with a blue pen?

A: Writing on paper keeps you away from screens. B: Digital files are easier to save.
★ Do you buy paper notebooks?

A: Typing is extremely fast and saves time. B: Writing slowly helps your brain think.
★ Is it more important to type fast?

A: A slow writing process helps you learn English. B: Slow work can make you tired.
★ Do you like a slow life?

A: Keeping a notebook is great for your ideas. B: Digital files are safer.
★ Do you have a paper notebook?

A: A big office chair is comfortable. B: Writing in bed with a book is cozy.
★ Is your study chair comfortable?

A: Making a mistake on paper is easy to erase. B: You can delete any mistake on computers.
★ Are you afraid of making a mistake?

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: deeper debate and statement evaluation in pairs/groups.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs, debate and state whether you agree or disagree with these statements:

ol.li:
A: Bad handwriting is very hard to read. B: Typing can feel cold and boring.
★ Have you ever struggled with bad handwriting?

A: Long typing can make your fingers tired. B: Writing by hand is too slow.
★ Does typing on phones make you tired?

A: A noisy keyboard distracts other people. B: Paper notes have no keys to help.
★ Does a noisy keyboard annoy you?

A: A leaking pen leaves stains on clothes. B: Without a computer, you cannot type.
★ Has a pen ever leaked?

A: Physical paper is easy to lose. B: Screens make your eyes very tired.
★ Have you ever lost important paper?

A: Writing too fast makes many typos. B: Slow work is bad for deadlines.
★ Do you make errors when typing fast?

A: A slow writer cannot take fast notes. B: Fast typing stops you from thinking.
★ Is a slow texter annoying?

A: Carrying a paper notebook is heavy. B: Digital files can be hacked.
★ Do you worry about your notebook?

A: Working at a table can be uncomfortable. B: Computers are uncomfortable for your eyes.
★ What is the most uncomfortable place to study?

A: Erasing a mistake looks messy on paper. B: Autocorrect can make a mistake.
★ Share a funny mistake you made.

ul.li: Incorrect: I write more fast with laptop → Correct: I write faster with a laptop ((Comparative form of 'fast' is 'faster'))
Incorrect: I have many homeworks → Correct: I have a lot of homework ((Homework is uncountable))
Incorrect: He work very slow → Correct: He works very slowly ((Third-person singular 's', adverb 'slowly'))
